name: Secure Clipboard
description:
Secrets-aware clipboard helper for the top panel.

Clipboard access: this extension reads the system clipboard to detect high-risk patterns (private keys, seed phrases, API tokens, long hex secrets, JWTs, and similar). Matching secrets are never stored in history. With auto-clear enabled (default), the clipboard and primary selection are cleared after a short timeout. Non-secret clips may be kept in a short in-memory history until the extension is disabled or the session ends.

Clipboard data is never sent to any network service. No telemetry.
